report_sections.title: Acquisitions and coverage
report_sections.text: T0 was acquired on 2026-06-21 and T1 on 2026-09-13. The acquisitions are 84 calendar days apart. T0: descending, left, track 107, frame 67. T1: descending, left, track 107, frame 67. The selection covers 5,932 × 3,652 native pixels, or 8,665.47 km² on the projected grid (EPSG:32640). Both dates have usable HH and HV at 21,099,696 native pixels. The detector works at 20 m spacing.

report_sections.title: Radar returns within the selection
report_sections.text: Median backscatter at T0 was HH -19.88 dB and HV -24.81 dB; at T1 it was HH -19.77 dB and HV -25.03 dB. The T1 minus T0 difference between date medians was HH +0.11 dB and HV -0.22 dB. Across both dates, average HH radar returns were strongest in the lower right and weakest in the middle left of the image frame.

report_sections.title: Where the detector flagged change
report_sections.text: At threshold 0.1, the detector flagged 999,843 of 21,099,696 valid model pixels (4.7%), equivalent to approximately 399.94 km² of flagged grid cells. The sectors with the most flags were middle left: 245,614 flags (24.6% of all flags; 10.2% of valid pixels within that sector); upper right: 228,702 flags (22.9% of all flags; 12.4% of valid pixels within that sector); middle right: 162,116 flags (16.2% of all flags; 6.7% of valid pixels within that sector).

report_sections.title: Flagged patches versus background
report_sections.text: Median of paired T1 minus T0 backscatter on the detector grid. middle left: flagged HH +4.71 dB, HV +0.84 dB; unflagged HH +0.69 dB, HV -0.04 dB. upper right: flagged HH -2.95 dB, HV -2.72 dB; unflagged HH -0.07 dB, HV -0.27 dB. middle right: flagged HH -1.97 dB, HV -1.89 dB; unflagged HH -0.08 dB, HV -0.23 dB.

report_sections.title: Context from the common footprint
report_sections.text: Across 123,084 matched samples from the shared HDF5 footprint, the T0 medians were HH -19.18 dB and HV -23.83 dB; the T1 medians were HH -18.82 dB and HV -23.94 dB. These are background statistics; the detector ran only inside the selected area.

report_sections.title: Model label and interpretation
report_sections.text: The linear model assigned “Other change” with a score of 84.4%. Radar flags are observations of backscatter change, not confirmation of a physical cause.

interpretation.limitation: These are hypotheses from two SAR acquisitions. Weak returns are not a water map, and the detector and linear label do not identify a physical cause.

finding.text: The detector flagged 399.94 km² · 4.7% of valid model cells.
